about: Lays out the navigation of an application as a column: a fixed header, scrolling content with blocks of destinations, and a fixed footer. Each block is a navigation landmark named by its label.

filtering.about: A search field that filters the pages. The query matches no page, so the block shows the empty message.
filtering.title: Filter

headings.about: One nav block named by `aria-label`, with a heading over each list. Each list takes its name from its heading through `aria-labelledby`.
headings.title: Headings

rail.about: The sidebar collapsed to a rail of icons. The labels and the words in the header and the footer are hidden visually and remain available to screen readers. The search and the block controls are removed.
rail.title: Rail

size.about: The three sizes. The size sets the padding, the gaps and the text of the header, the labels and the footer. The navigation list and the search field take the same size through their own props.
size.title: Sizes

title: Sidebar

variant.about: The four looks. `outline` has a hairline at the inline end, `plain` is transparent, `subtle` has a muted ground, and `surface` has the panel ground, a hairline on every side and a shadow. The app shell sets the width, so each sidebar renders in a room the width of a sidebar.
variant.title: Looks
